posts.title: Your public Telegram community can be banned in the blink of an eye
posts.description: Early this morning, I experienced a situation that proves just how fragile managing a community is today. Our public VallaBus group, a space of nearly 150 people that took me years of hard work to cultivate and keep alive, was completely banned out of nowhere. Read more →

posts.title: Tu comunidad en Telegram puede ser bloqueada en un abrir y cerrar de ojos
posts.description: Esta madrugada he vivido una situación que demuestra lo frágil que es gestionar una comunidad hoy en día. Nuestro grupo público de VallaBus, un espacio de casi 150 personas que ha costado años cultivar y mantener vivo con mucho esfuerzo, fue bloqueado de un plumazo. Read more →

posts.title: Aldea Pucela: How we created the biggest online citizen community in Valladolid in 3 months
posts.description: In 2025 I am focusing my efforts on strengthening the social fabric by creating an online citizen community in my city, Valladolid (Spain). In just three months, we have gone from an idea to a platform with more than 1500 members. Read more →
